blocks.text: BAYOMBONG, NUEVA VIZCAYA—A regional trial court (RTC) in this province rejected a petition filed by a mining firm to stop residents from maintaining barricades they put up on roads leading to their exploration site in mineral-rich Kasibu town. In his seven-page order issued on Nov. 11, Bambang RTC Judge Eric Banasan of Branch 37 denied the application for a preliminary injunction filed by the North Luzon Mineral Resources Corp. (NLMRC) and the Bugkalot Confederation of Nueva Vizcaya, Quirino and Aurora Inc. for “lack of merit” and dissolved the court’s 20-day temporary restraining order for being “moot.” The court cited insufficient evidence […]...
